title: Plan single-column SELECT DISTINCT direct scan
problem: SELECT DISTINCT single_column currently materializes full rows, projects values, then clones full result rows into a HashSet for deduplication. The benchmark DISTINCT query and subquery DISTINCT inner scans pay that cost repeatedly.
approach: Detect SELECT DISTINCT single column from one base table with no WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, or OFFSET.
Resolve the target column once against schema.
Scan table rows and decode only the target column with RowDecoder::decode_column.
Deduplicate directly while preserving first-seen output order and returning one-column rows.
expected_impact: Improve Never-ordered items by accelerating its inner SELECT DISTINCT product_id subquery.
risk_controls: Keep ORDER BY, LIMIT, multi-column DISTINCT, and expression DISTINCT on existing generic path.
Add SQL integration coverage for alias and NULL preservation.
